attr.title: Dominatrix (SiN)
attr.desc: A modernized, gamepad-native source port of SiN, Ritual Entertainment's 1998 id Tech 2 shooter. Features widescreen support and a choice of classic OpenGL or OpenGL 3.2 renderers. Requires your own copy of SiN: Gold's game data. Includes a launcher for the Wages of SiN expansion.
attr.inst: Copy the contents of your SiN: Gold install's base folder into dominatrix/base (do not overwrite the existing game.so). For the Wages of SiN expansion, copy the 2015 folder into dominatrix/2015 (again keep the existing game.so). See README.md for details.
